job.title: Registered Nurses - Aged Care
job.description:
About the Opportunity

Take your career further with First Choice Care as an Aged Care Registered Nurse. You’ll work across Gold Coast's leading Aged Care facilities, making a true impact on resident care every shift. Enjoy the flexibility to choose AM, PM, or Night Duty shifts that fit your lifestyle- perfect for balancing work and personal commitments. Earn excellent pay rates of up to $125 per hour (level dependant) plus superannuation and employee perks, while gaining valuable experience.

What’s in it for you?
  • Excellent Rates of Pay – Earn more for the valuable work you do
  • Choose When & Where You Work - via our easy-to-use app
  • Plenty of Choice – large client base means more shifts available
  • Weekly Pay – Enjoy reliable, regular income
  • 24/7 Support – including clinical, allocations & wellbeing (EAP)
  • Free Uniform - Designed and loved by our nurses
  • Staff Perks – Fitness Passport, discounts, training offers & referral rewards
Who we’re looking for

We’re seeking experienced and dedicated Aged Care Registered Nurse's who meet the following requirements:
  • Recent clinical experience in Aged Care
  • Bachelor of Nursing (or equivalent) with current AHPRA registration  
  • Work rights in Australia  
  • A Valid National Police Check
  • Up-to-date Vaccinations
About Us:
 
First Choice Care is one of Australia’s leading staffing agencies, specialising in aged care, healthcare, and clinical facilitation. With over 20 years of experience, we recruit for casual shifts, short-term contracts, and permanent roles across more than 700 public and private facilities nationwide. Committed to supporting our team every step of the way, we are also proud to be part of the PeopleIN network — Australia’s largest talent solutions provider. 
  
Ready to take control of your future? Apply today and step into a role that puts you first- more opportunities, more flexibility and more rewards with First Choice Care.

job.title: Registered Nurses - ICU, CCU, ED & HDU
job.description:
About the Opportunity

Take your career further with First Choice Care as an ICU, CCU, ED or HDU Registered Nurse. You’ll work across leading hospitals in Brisbane or Ipswich, making a true impact on patient care every shift. Enjoy the flexibility to choose AM, PM, or Night Duty shifts that fit your lifestyle- perfect for balancing work and personal commitments. Earn excellent pay rates of up to $146 per hour (level dependant) plus superannuation and employee perks, while gaining valuable experience in specialty care settings.

What’s in it for you?
  • Competitive Pay: Get rewarded for your skills, with higher rates for your essential work.
  • Flexible Shifts: Match your roster to your lifestyle and choose your preferred hospitals via our intuitive app.
  • More Opportunities: Access a wide variety of shifts, thanks to our extensive client network.
  • Weekly Payments: Count on regular, reliable income every week.
  • 24/7 Support: Enjoy clinical, allocations and wellbeing assistance whenever you need it (including EAP services).
  • Free Uniform: Designed by our nurses, for our nurses.
  • Exclusive Benefits: Access perks like Fitness Passport, training discounts and referral rewards.

We’re seeking experienced and dedicated ICU, CCU, ED or HDU Registered Nurses who meet the following requirements:
  • Bachelor of Nursing
  • Current AHPRA registration
  • Recent experience in either ICU, CCU, ED or HDU

  • A valid Employment National Police Check
